bill_of_materials.why: Links tube assemblies to components with a quantity on the link.

comp_adaptor.why: One row per adaptor component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_boss.why: One row per boss component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_elbow.why: One row per elbow component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_float.why: One row per float component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_hfl.why: One row per hfl component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_nut.why: One row per nut component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_other.why: One row per other component keyed by component_id with part name and weight, a subtype of components.

comp_sleeve.why: One row per sleeve component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_straight.why: One row per straight component keyed by component_id with its dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_tee.why: Four tee components keyed by component_id with their dimensions, a subtype of components.

comp_threaded.why: One row per threaded component keyed by component_id with up to four ends' dimensions, a subtype of components.

components.why: One row per component keyed by component_id with name and type; bill_of_materials and every comp_ table point at it.

spec.why: Links tube assemblies to specification codes; the codes have no table of their own.

target.why: One row per supplier price quote for a tube assembly, stamped with quote_date; tube_assembly_id repeats.

tube.why: One row per tube assembly keyed by tube_assembly_id with material and geometry; bill_of_materials, spec and target point at it.

tube_end_form.why: 27 end-form codes with a forming flag, pointed at only by tube (end_a and end_x).

type_component.why: 29 component-type codes with their name, pointed at by components and most comp_ tables.

type_connection.why: 14 connection-type codes with their name, pointed at by several comp_ tables.

type_end_form.why: Eight end-form codes with their name, pointed at by several comp_ tables.
